content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 (prior auth missing at time of service); the retro-auth window is closed, no peer-to-peer is offered, and an appeal was already filed with no new payer response on the table. There is no valid payer avenue left to recover payment, and because the denial stems from a provider failure to obtain required authorization, the balance cannot properly be shifted to the patient. The only correct progression is to close the uncollectible balance.","action":"write_off"}
